{{Top|leg}}
'''Jugsmuk Fair''' was one of the largest fairs that occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] during [[slushtime]]. Due to the presence of [[Jugsmuk Station]], one of the only true [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on the world, the fair attracted both off-world attention and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] from all over the [[Wugguh]] continent. Jugsmuk Fair hosted a large fighting tournament for boars, but it was principally a training fair. Young tuskers would issue their first challenges, while older tuskers would hone their skills and be watchful of the competition.<ref name="MS">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>
